paragraphs: He is mentioned in Beitzah 38b: Rav Safra said, “Have they not heard what Rabbi Chiyya Ketosfa’ah said in Rav’s name?” In Yevamot 104a we find Rabbah bar Chiyya Ketosfa’ah.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Beitzah 38b explicitly writes Rabbi Chiyya Ketosfa’ah reporting in Rav’s name; Yevamot 104a names Rabbah bar Chiyya Ketosfa’ah. These occurrences support the names and source-specific titles, without independently establishing a genealogical connection.
